column1: # Secrets manifest (PUBLIC: names, paths, owners and modes only; never values). Tab-separated, one row per SSM parameter.
# Read by scripts/fetch-secrets.sh and by scripts/set-secret.sh --check. The SecureString rows (not config/*) are OWNER-managed, not
# Terraform-managed (ADR-013), and this file is the source of truth for that list. Adding a service: add a row here, then run
# scripts/set-secret.sh --create <name> and set the value. Only config/* rows are Terraform's (terraform/edge/ssm.tf);
# scripts/test-fetch-secrets.sh checks that those agree.
# parameter : name under /home-lab/ (secrets are SecureString; config/* are String owned by Terraform)
# target    : file under the secrets dir (default /apps/secrets); no leading slash, no ..
# owner     : numeric uid:gid of the file (never 1000, the Pi login user; ids are defined in config/lab.env); mode: octal, e.g. 0400
# required  : yes   = fail closed if the parameter is missing or still holds the UNSET- placeholder
#             no    = omit the file while the placeholder is in place
#             empty = write an EMPTY file while the placeholder is in place (e.g. Tailscale after the node has joined)
# format    : raw = file holds the value exactly; env:NAME = a line NAME=value appended to the target
#             (several rows may share one env: target, which must agree on owner and mode)
authentik/secret-key
# postgres-password is read by Authentik (uid 10002, owner) and by PostgreSQL (uid 70, through group 10002): hence 0440.
authentik/postgres-password
# bootstrap-password: an EMPTY file while UNSET (the compose secret needs the file to exist); the worker exports it only when non-empty.
authentik/bootstrap-password
# breakglass-htpasswd is read by Traefik, which runs as TRAEFIK_UID (10004, non-root).
traefik/breakglass-htpasswd
tailscale/auth-key
homepage/authentik-token
# pihole/admin-password (M8): the Pi-hole web login behind Authentik. Read once at start by the image's root entrypoint (WEBPASSWORD_FILE).
pihole/admin-password
# Linkwarden (M9), all machine-only (scripts/set-secret.sh --generate). postgres-password: Linkwarden (10007, owner) and its PostgreSQL
# (uid 70, through group 10007), hence 0440. oidc-client-secret: the Authentik worker (10002, owner; the blueprint reads it) and
# Linkwarden (group 10007), hence 10002:10007 0440, in the authentik/ directory.
linkwarden/postgres-password
linkwarden/nextauth-secret
linkwarden/meili-key
linkwarden/oidc-client-secret
# portainer/admin-password (M11): the owner's Portainer login (a human password: scripts/set-secret.sh prompts). Portainer runs as
# root inside its container (the Docker socket is root's) and reads it once, on its first start.
portainer/admin-password
# R19 apps (docs/runbooks/r19-apps.md). n8n/encryption-key: n8n's N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE (it encrypts every stored credential; losing it makes
# them unreadable, and it is never in git or the nightly backup: SSM is its only copy). couchdb/*: the CouchDB admin and cookie secret are
# machine-only (--generate); the sync password is a human password typed into Obsidian. speedtest/app-key: Laravel APP_KEY seed, read by the
# root init script (converted to base64 inside the container); speedtest/admin-password: the Speedtest Tracker admin login (a human password,
# 64 characters or fewer: Laravel's bcrypt limit).
n8n/encryption-key
couchdb/admin-password
couchdb/cookie-secret
couchdb/sync-password
speedtest/app-key
speedtest/admin-password
config/domain
config/route53-zone-id
config/ra-trust-anchor-arn
config/ra-acme-profile-arn
config/ra-acme-role-arn
config/pi-lan-ip
